title: Ultrahuman media placeholder
description: A plain token-coloured surface standing in for a photo, video or render until a real one is passed in: a mid-grey photo wash, a pale warm studio surface, a faint radial wash for renders, or a soft glow band.
notes: size and radius come from the parent or className
name: ultrahuman-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description:
photo: a mid-grey ink wash that reads on any band · warm: a pale studio surface (product
shots) · soft: a faint radial wash for renders and art · glow: a soft band of the theme's glow

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will hold, read to screen readers (e.g. "Photo of a runner")
